user: cara build APK Capacitor dari project web
assistant:
```bash
npm install @capacitor/core @capacitor/cli @capacitor/android
npx cap init
npx cap add android
npm run build   # pastikan folder web (www/dist) siap
npx cap copy android
npx cap open android
```
Di Android Studio: Build → Build APK(s). Untuk release butuh keystore.

user: beda debug APK vs release signed
assistant: Debug: ditandatangani debug key, mudah di-install saat development. Release: ditandatangani keystore production, wajib untuk Play Store / distribusi serius. Jangan hilangkan keystore.

```bash
keytool -genkey -v -keystore miko-release.keystore -alias miko -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
```
Simpan password & file di tempat aman (bukan di git).

Internet: `INTERNET`. Notifikasi (Android 13+): `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`. Storage modern: scoped storage, hindari legacy WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE jika tidak perlu. Minta runtime permission hanya saat fitur dipakai.

user: cara cek update APK dari GitHub Release
assistant: APK cek `https://api.github.com/repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest` atau tag `latest`, bandingkan commit/version di `build.json`, unduh asset `.apk`, lalu minta user install (Android tidak izinkan silent update di luar Play Store).
Capacitor: modern, maintenance lebih aktif, plugin mirip, integrasi native lebih jelas. Cordova: lebih lama. Untuk project baru, Capacitor biasanya pilihan lebih baik.
Chrome → `chrome://inspect` → pilih WebView device. Pastikan `android:debuggable` atau build debug. Log JS muncul di console.
Sering: aset gambar besar, native lib multi-ABI, model AI lokal. Solusi: webp, ABI splits, kompres model, jangan bundel file training.

user: cara test APK di HP tanpa Play Store
assistant: Aktifkan 'Install from unknown sources' / izinkan browser/file manager. Transfer APK via USB/cable atau unduh dari Release GitHub, lalu buka file.
Siapkan icon 1024x1024 dan splash. Pakai `@capacitor/assets` atau ganti manual di `android/app/src/main/res`. Jalankan generate assets lalu `npx cap sync`.
